evidence.counting_rule: For each of the 44 frozen probes, count how many of the 9 checklist categories describe a semantically material behavior that occurs in the Quidra fragment without being signaled by the fixed local syntax at the use site, per capability_universe.json canonical_task and R1-R10 authoring rules. A behavior already made unambiguous by fixed local syntax under the language spec (e.g. Quidra explicit conversions, explicit references, explicit try/error unions, explicit generic constraints, static-only method resolution) is excluded per the frozen exclusion clause. Probes scored NONE for Quidra (no fragment exists) are excluded from this metric's basis and reported separately; their absence is scored only through Capability Coverage C, not Hidden Semantic Cost.
evidence.double_counting_avoidance: Each probe's count reflects distinct underlying rules; a single runtime-panic mechanism (checked arithmetic/bounds/allocation) is counted once per probe under implicit_exception_or_failure_propagation and not duplicated under context_dependent_overflow_numeric_behavior for the same construct, per semantic_compression.md instruction not to count the same underlying rule twice inside one metric.
evidence.methodology_reference: benchmark/template/methodology-assets/semantic_compression: semantic_compression.md section D; checklist frozen before annotation per common.md methodology.
evidence.normalization_formula: score = 100 * (1 - total_hidden_count / (probes_in_basis * 9)), where probes_in_basis excludes NONE-support probes for Quidra and 9 is the fixed checklist size per probe.
evidence.note_on_shard_scope: This packet is language-sharded to Quidra only per assigned_requirements.json; the runner is responsible for merging this shard with the other nine languages' disjoint shards for metric.hidden_semantic_cost before aggregation, per worker_core.md and primary.json max_requirement_ids_per_multi_language_agent constraints.

per_probe_hidden_counts.notes: Immutable local binding; value/mutability/init/type all locally explicit.
Explicit mutable storage vs explicit named constant; both locally marked.
Definite-initialization is compiler-checked on every branch before read; no hidden state.
implicit_exception_or_failure_propagation: array(n) can fail on invalid allocation size without a union/try marker at the call site.
implicit_exception_or_failure_propagation: compound-assignment overflow is a deterministic runtime panic (status 101) not signaled by the += syntax itself.
implicit_exception_or_failure_propagation: indexed element write can fail on out-of-range index without a locally visible error type.
Writable alias uses explicit & syntax at both formation and dereference.
const T & view is an explicit non-copying read-only path per spec; no hidden copy.
ref.Cell<T> identity sharing is an explicit opt-in mechanism (architecture.md); ordinary classes do not silently gain identity semantics.

implicit_allocation_copy_move_destruction_cleanup: ordinary by-value argument passing performs a deep independent copy of the aggregate that is not visible at the bare call-site expression itself (only knowable from the global value-semantics rule).
Explicit &data / T& parameter marks writable-alias passing at both declaration and call site.
implicit_exception_or_failure_propagation: element access inside the callee can fail on bounds without that being visible in the signature.
Multiple results returned via an explicit small class with named fields; both results and their types are explicit at the declaration.

context_dependent_overflow_numeric_behavior counted narrowly as implicit_exception_or_failure_propagation: a*b+c can trap on overflow with no local syntax difference from a non-overflowing expression.

implicit_exception_or_failure_propagation: integer division/remainder can fail on runtime zero divisor without a union/try marker; explicit float(a)/float(b) avoids any implicit conversion hidden cost.

implicit_exception_or_failure_propagation: Quidra provides only the single optimized checked-arithmetic mode (no wrapping/saturating/optional rung available), so m+1 traps deterministically without a locally distinguishing operator.
The explicit b==0 guard makes the zero-divisor outcome fully locally visible; no hidden path remains.
String content equality is the only == meaning for string; no user-defined/dynamic dispatch is possible (static method resolution).
sorted() is documented non-mutating and returns an independent runtime-sized value; no hidden in-place mutation.
implicit_exception_or_failure_propagation: explicit int32(big) narrowing is range-checked and fails deterministically at runtime without a locally visible error type on the cast expression itself.
Quidra forbids implicit mixed-type arithmetic; i + d requires an explicit float(i) conversion, so no implicit conversion is hidden.
implicit_exception_or_failure_propagation: xs[i] traps on out-of-range i with no local syntax difference from an in-range access.
Quidra has no built-in aliasing array slice; the substituted explicit copy loop makes copy behavior fully visible (P-a substitution).
int | none absence and explicit match/fallback extraction are fully visible in the type and the statement.
No optional-chaining combinator exists; the substituted explicit match makes the short-circuit fully visible (P-a substitution).
int | error return type and try both declare failure and propagation explicitly in the signature and body.
Local match/fallback handling of int | error is fully explicit; no hidden unwinding.
enum Shape is a closed, exhaustively-checked alternative set; nominal typing is explicit.
match is compiler-enforced exhaustive with no implicit default/else arm permitted.
Monomorphized generic function; concrete instantiation is explicit and statically checked.
Built-in ordered constraint is declared at the generic declaration site; misuse is diagnosed there, not hidden until instantiation.
implicit_exception_or_failure_propagation: the summation loop's accumulator addition can overflow-trap without a locally distinguishing marker.
map.Map insertion order and .get returning V | none are both documented and explicit at the call site.

implicit_allocation_copy_move_destruction_cleanup: file.Handle closes deterministically at end of binding lifetime with no explicit with/defer/using marker at the open call site (architecture.md: 'no defer or manual cleanup required').
print is an always-visible standard namespace member; no import ambiguity.
Quidra's private prefix is class-member-only; the substituted class-based encapsulation makes the visibility boundary fully explicit at both declaration and call site (P-a substitution).
task.all explicitly starts and joins both operations before returning; result placement order is documented and explicit.
atomic.Counter.add is a documented sequentially-consistent checked read-modify-write; race-freedom is an explicit normative guarantee, not hidden.
extern C declaration states the exact C symbol, ABI-stable scalar types, and call is marked foreign at the declaration; no hidden calling convention choice remains once the scalar types are fixed.

probes_excluded_no_fragment_none_support.reason: Quidra function values are explicitly capture-free; language.md/architecture.md state no closure environment is allocated or inferred, so the canonical_task's captured-local closure cannot be expressed.

Quidra classes have no inheritance/dynamic-dispatch extension mechanism; reuse is explicit composition only (language.md), so a third alternative cannot be added from a separate unit through an existing abstract operation.

architecture.md states method selection is static and there is no dynamic dispatch or hidden subtype relation; a heterogeneous sequence dispatched at runtime through one abstract element type is not expressible.

Quidra has no user-defined deterministic end-of-lifetime hook (destructor/deinit) for ordinary classes; only compiler-owned runtime resource types (e.g. file.Handle) close automatically, and that mechanism is not exposed to user class declarations.

The C FFI section only defines the inbound direction (extern declarations calling foreign C symbols); Quidra defines no mechanism to export a Quidra function under a stable unmangled C-callable symbol.
